# Tollgate

> AI Reliability & Control Plane — Protect · Route · Prove.
> Self-hosted admission, budgets, agent-loop hard stops, health routing, chaos/DR proof.
> Not another LLM gateway catalog.

## Start here

- [README](README.md)
- [5-minute setup](docs/GETTING_STARTED.md)
- [Product wedge](docs/PRODUCT.md)
- [Repo map (searchable index)](docs/MAP.md)
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)

## Find anything

```bash
tollgate search <query>           # modules, docs, HTTP, CLI
tollgate search circuit breaker
tollgate search budget --kind concept
tollgate search /v1/messages --kind http
tollgate search --map             # full markdown map
```

## Core code

- HTTP surface: `src/tollgate/server_v1.py` (:8787 `/v1/*`)
- Admission: `src/tollgate/gateway/admit.py`
- Circuits: `src/tollgate/gateway/circuit.py`
- Router: `src/tollgate/router.py`
- Agent protection: `src/tollgate/agent_guard.py`
- OpenAI drop-in: `src/tollgate/openai_compat.py`
- Anthropic drop-in: `src/tollgate/anthropic_compat.py`
- Streaming: `src/tollgate/chat_stream.py`
- Control plane: `src/tollgate/control_plane.py`
- Chaos/DR: `src/tollgate/chaos.py`
- Resilience score: `src/tollgate/resilience.py`
- Provider truth (data): `src/tollgate/distill/*.json`
- CLI: `src/tollgate/cli.py`
- Repo search: `src/tollgate/repo_search.py`

## HTTP

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| GET | /v1/health |
| GET | /v1/control |
| GET | /v1/resilience |
| GET | /dashboard |
| POST | /v1/route |
| POST | /v1/invoke |
| GET/POST | /v1/config |
| GET | /v1/models |
| POST | /v1/chat/completions |
| POST | /v1/messages |
| GET | /metrics |
